item.title: OFC U-16 Women’s Championship: Junior Kulas thrash Cook Islands 11-0
item.description: Fiji’s Junior Kulas have made a stunning start to the OFC U-16 Women’s Championship after thrashing the Cook Islands 11-0 in Honiara, Solomon Islands. Adi Reva was the star of the match, scoring five goals as Fiji dominated from the opening whistle.
item.content:encoded:
Fiji’s Junior Kulas have made a stunning start to the OFC U-16 Women’s Championship after thrashing the Cook Islands 11-0 in Honiara, Solomon Islands.

Adi Reva was the star of the match, scoring five goals as Fiji dominated from the opening whistle.

Torika Boseiwaqa opened the scoring from the penalty spot in the fifth minute before adding her second in the 26th minute.

Esther Vunivi also scored before Reva began her five-goal haul with two goals before half-time.

Reva completed her hat-trick in the 50th minute before adding two more goals late in the match.

Temalesi Masi scored twice after coming off the bench, while Elisha Narayan completed the scoring with the final kick of the game.

The result is Fiji’s biggest-ever win at the OFC U-16 Women’s Championship, with Reva also becoming the first Fijian player to score five goals in a single match at the tournament.

Head coach Nicola Demaine praised the performance but urged her players to remain focused on their next match.

Demaine says the team must not get carried away despite the impressive opening result.

Fiji will next face New Zealand on Wednesday at 5pm before taking on the Solomon Islands next Saturday at 8pm.

The semi-finals will be played on 16th September, with the final scheduled for 19th September.

The winner and the runner-up will qualify for FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup 2027.

item.title: EPL: Arsenal come from behind to beat Chelsea 2-1
item.description: Reigning Premier League champions Arsenal came from behind to defeat Chelsea 2-1 at the Emirates Stadium. Chelsea shocked the home supporters when they took the lead just two minutes into the match through Morgan Rogers. The goal was the first Arsenal had conceded this season.
item.content:encoded:
Reigning Premier League champions Arsenal came from behind to defeat Chelsea 2-1 at the Emirates Stadium.

Chelsea shocked the home supporters when they took the lead just two minutes into the match through Morgan Rogers. The goal was the first Arsenal had conceded this season.

However, the Gunners responded with an equaliser from Kai Havertz in the 25th minute, with the scores locked at 1-all at half-time.

Arsenal then completed the comeback in the 50th minute when captain Martin Odegaard found the back of the net after a clever dummy from Havertz , giving the Gunners a 2-1 lead.

The goal was Odegaard's second in three Premier League matches.

Chelsea pushed hard for an equaliser late in the match, but the Gunners held on.

The defeat was Chelsea's fifth straight Premier League loss at the Emirates Stadium.

Meanwhile, Manchester United and Everton settled for a 2-all draw.

item.title: From football to the Drua: Boselawa credits dad and faith for his rugby journey

item.content:encoded:
From playing football throughout his school years to only taking up rugby at 19, Kavekini Karl Boselawa’s journey to becoming a Senior Development Player has been driven by faith, perseverance and the unwavering support of his family, especially his father.

Boselawa says rugby was not always the path he thought he would take, as he played football throughout primary and high school and only played touch rugby with the boys in his village during school holidays.

It was not until he was 19 and studying at university that he played rugby for the first time.

Boselawa attended Nadrala Sangam, Sigatoka Methodist and later spent three years at Fiji National University.

He says completing his education was important to him, and he finished university before deciding to seriously pursue rugby.

That decision has now paid off, with Boselawa saying receiving his official offer to become a Senior Development Player was an emotional moment that initially left him in disbelief.

He says the first thing that came to mind when he received the news was, “What?!”, adding he was excited, happy and thankful to God for the opportunity.

Behind his journey has been the strong influence of his father , whom Boselawa calls his “Tou”.

Boselawa says his father has had the biggest influence on him, both as a man and throughout his rugby journey.

He also says his father is a former rugby player who played centre, fullback and wing, the same positions Boselawa plays , and has been able to share his rugby experience and guidance with his son.

Boselawa says one of the biggest lessons his father has taught him is the importance of putting God first in everything he does and trusting that everything else will follow.

His father says the family is extremely proud of Kave and thanked him, his mother and their entire family for helping him reach the milestone.

He says it was also a special moment for the family to have the Drua visit their home as Boselawa begins the next chapter of his rugby journey.

He says they give all the glory to God for the opportunity and milestone.

item.title: La Liga: Yamal scores twice as Barcelona thrash Valencia 5-0
item.description: Lamine Yamal scored twice as Barcelona continued their impressive start to the La Liga season with a 5-0 win over Valencia. Yamal opened the scoring in the sixth minute before Fermín López doubled Barcelona’s lead in the 22nd minute.
item.content:encoded:
Lamine Yamal scored twice as Barcelona continued their impressive start to the La Liga season with a 5-0 win over Valencia.

Yamal opened the scoring in the sixth minute before Fermín López doubled Barcelona’s lead in the 22nd minute.

Raphinha made it 3-0 shortly after the break, with Pedri adding Barcelona’s fourth in the 79th minute.

Yamal completed the scoring with his second goal of the match in the 84th minute.

Barcelona have now scored 17 goals in four matches and conceded just two.

Valencia remain bottom with just one point from their opening four games.

Meanwhile, Alavés thrashed Osasuna 5-2, while Málaga and Levante played out a goalless draw.

Espanyol and Sevilla are currently in action.
